body_html:
Hometown: St. Petersburg, Florida
DJ Since: 2017

DJ Darryl C brings energy, creativity, and a deep passion for music to every event he performs. Originally from St. Petersburg, Florida, Darryl discovered his love for DJing through his passion for music and the art of mixing tracks to create unforgettable moments on the dance floor. Since starting in 2017, he has continued to develop his style and grow as an entertainer who knows how to keep a crowd engaged from start to finish.

Darryl has experience hosting and MC’ing weddings and events, giving him the ability to guide a celebration while maintaining the energy and excitement that keeps guests involved. His favorite part of being a DJ is the connection with the crowd—there’s nothing better than hearing guests sing along to their favorite songs and seeing the dance floor come alive.

When it comes to music, Darryl has a wide-ranging taste and enjoys playing just about everything depending on the event’s vibe. From hip-hop and throwbacks to high-energy party anthems, he focuses on reading the crowd and playing the right song at the right moment to keep people dancing all night long. Some of his go-to party starters include classics like “Get Low,” “No Hands,” and “This Is How We Do It,” which always seem to get the crowd moving.

Darryl especially enjoys high-energy environments such as packed dance floors, hype parties, and even unique events like silent discos where creativity and crowd engagement really shine. His approach is simple, pay attention to the audience, understand the energy in the room, and build a musical experience that people will remember.

Outside of DJing, Darryl works as a leasing agent for a property management company. He’s also a creative at heart with talents that extend beyond music, including playing guitar, photography, graphic design, and videography. In his downtime, he enjoys creating social media content, spending time on TikTok, and relaxing with some gaming on his PS5. Family is important to him as well, and he grew up with supportive parents and two younger sisters.

Above all, Darryl loves meeting new people and bringing positive energy to every event he’s part of.

Why Book DJ Darryl C with JAMMIN’ DJs?
DJ Darryl C is the kind of DJ who understands how to read a room and keep people moving. With years of experience behind the decks, he knows how to build momentum on the dance floor and create an atmosphere where guests feel comfortable letting loose and having fun. His passion for music, ability to connect with a crowd, and creative energy make him a great choice for anyone looking for an entertaining and engaging DJ experience.
